evals.name: single-status-report
evals.prompt: I only have a screenshot of our weekly status slide (inputs/status-report.png). Can you turn it into an editable PowerPoint so I can update the table and dates? Save the .pptx into outputs/.
evals.expected_output: 1-slide pptx: native text, native tables for both tables, the 3 header icons and timeline markers as separate vector/image assets, no full-slide raster
assertions: PPTX delivered in outputs/ and opens as a valid package
Slide count matches input page count and order
No full-slide screenshot left under editable text
At least 90% of key strings are native editable text
Non-text visuals are separate movable objects
Icons embedded as SVG vectors (PowerPoint Convert-to-Shape capable)
Tables rebuilt as native PowerPoint tables

evals.name: flattened-pptx-notes
evals.prompt: inputs/flattened_review.pptx came out of an export tool with every slide flattened into a picture. Make it a normal editable deck again - and please don't lose my speaker notes. Save to outputs/.
evals.expected_output: 2-slide pptx, same order; text/tables/icons editable; speaker notes copied verbatim to matching slides
